----------------
 Coram: Neeraj P. Dhote, J.

ORAL JUDGMENT This is an Appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short "L.A. Act") by the original Claimant for compensation for the acquired land admeasuring 7.04 R of village Malapur,
Taluka Babhulgaon, District Yavatmal for submergence under the Bembla River Project.
The learned Reference Court has awarded the compensation at the rate of Rs.1,70,000/- per Hectare.

The learned Advocate for the Appellant placed reliance on the judgment of this Court dated 05.02.2026 in First Appeal 2 fa560.2015.odt No.488/2015 to contend that, the similarly placed Claimant is granted compensation @ of Rs.2,10,000/- for the dry crop land from the same village for the same project and prays that, the Appeal be allowed in terms of the said judgment.
2. The learned Advocate for the Acquiring Body does not dispute the aforesaid aspect.

sentences.text: This Court decided the Appeal and awarded the compensation at the rate of Rs.2,10,000/- per Hectare for the dry crop land from the same village Malapur for the land which was acquired for the same project.
The land of the Appellant is also dry crop land.
In view of the above judgment of this Court, the Claimant is entitled for the same rate on the ground of parity.

Hence, the Appeal is allowed in terms of the aforesaid judgment in First Appeal No.488/2015 by the following order:-
ORDER i)
The Appeal is partly allowed.
ii) The Appellant shall be entitled for compensation @ of Rs.2,10,000/- for the dry crop land.
iii) The award passed by the learned Reference Court stands modified to this extent.

iv) The Appellant would not be entitled for the interest for the period of delay i.e.
15.03.2004 to 17.04.2015.
v) The Acquiring Body is expected to deposit the enhanced amount of compensation within a period of six (6) months.
(NEERAJ P. DHOTE, J.) Tambaskar.
